dialog.title: Configure: {button}
dialog.keys_help:
What you can type
• One key: E, F1, Space
• Keys pressed together: er or E+R
• With modifiers: Ctrl+2, Shift+A, Ctrl+er
• Key names: Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Super, Enter, Esc, Tab, Space, Backspace, Up, Down, Left, Right, F1–F24, Num 0–9, Right Ctrl
• A name wins over its letters: end is the End key; type E+N+D for the letters.
• Or click Record and press the keys.
Names are physical keys (US layout); your keyboard layout still applies.
